howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Draw white-out rectangles
howto.text: Specify region(s) per page to cover with white (or chosen color). Content underneath is permanently hidden from view.

howto.name: Download the cleaned PDF
howto.text: Hidden regions are covered with the chosen color in the rendered output.

faq.q: Is whiteout the same as redaction?
faq.a: No — whiteout covers content visually but the underlying text remains in the file. For permanent redaction (text removed), use Redact PDF or Smart Redact.

faq.q: Can I use any color, not just white?
faq.a: Yes — color is configurable. Black for blackout style, white for whiteout, any custom hex color for matching background.

faq.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Yes — the cover rectangle is added on top of the rendered page. Behind, the original pixels are still in the file.
